practice_learning_route_resolution:
  identity: one immutable receipt per task_instance_id
  purpose: freeze idempotent decision output across retries
  canonical_runtime_snapshot_owner: ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator
course_plan_request:
  lease: renewed between bounded downstream operations; worker lease TTL exceeds one downstream HTTP timeout
  learning_path_id: nullable exact Student-owned path; absent for an unallocated INITIAL/NO_GAP, required on accepted REPLAN, checkpointed immediately after Student allocation
  request_hash: binds caller-supplied learning_path_id for REPLAN; omission retains the v1 INITIAL hash input
  migration: 006 adds learning_path_id and permits both v1 and v2 outbox rows
  exact_path_command_checkpoint: nullable all-or-none kind, expected version, SHA-256 hash, JSON body, checkpoint timestamp, and private planned outcome; written compare-and-set under the active claim before REPLAN/NO_GAP delivery
  checkpoint_identity: hash binds student_id, request ID used as planning_request_id and Student Idempotency-Key, learning_path_id, command kind, expected path version, private planned outcome, and normalized exact body
  retry: transport ambiguity retains and replays the checkpoint without any Student state read or payload rebuild
  outcome_visibility: public result_code/course_id/reused stay empty during transport ambiguity and terminal conflict; the private planned outcome is promoted only immediately before Complete after confirmed Student success
  terminal_retention: COMPLETED/FAILED clears claim and lease but retains checkpoint and its private planned outcome for audit
  diagnostic_plan_id: nullable Planner-local immutable placement link; allowed only Teacher INITIAL and excluded from public/event/path payloads
  diagnostic_initial_allocation: migration 017 freezes initial_allocation_json plus SHA-256 before Student assignment/allocation; exact request/student/diagnostic identity and initial desired body remain immutable through retries
  diagnostic_resume: only stable-key diagnostic INITIAL ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED resets attempts and lease; request ID, generated draft, path and checkpoint retained
  migration_007: adds the exact-path command checkpoint without backfilling historical rows

Hybrid_replanning_v1:
  migration: 020_hybrid_replanning
  tables: [hybrid_planning_state_inbox, hybrid_evaluation_work, hybrid_evaluation_job]
  inbox: immutable event ID and normalized payload hash; changed-payload replay conflicts
  work: one generation queue per student/path; claim token and expiring lease fence checkpoint and release
  job: immutable coherent Student snapshot per student/path/snapshot_ref/hybrid-replan-v1
  coalescing: snapshot checkpoint processes only claimed generation; newer committed events remain pending
  mutation: no Student mutation in trigger or snapshot worker
  rollback: refuse any retained inbox/work/job under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks
  rollout: isolated validation then explicit manual migration and canonical stream provisioning before worker deployment

Hybrid_consequences_v1:
  migration: 021_hybrid_consequences
  tables: [hybrid_consequence_work, hybrid_consequence_input, hybrid_consequence_receipt]
  inputs: first pinned existing PolicyBundle and bounded published prerequisite graph per snapshot job; immutable and hash-verified
  retry: stored pins override later activation observations
  receipt: one deterministic NO_CHANGE or REPLAN_NEEDED result per job; exact replay returns same receipt, changed payload conflicts
  atomicity: immutable consequence and completed evaluation work commit together under unexpired claim
  storage_validation: deterministic pure evaluator must reproduce the stored consequence from stored snapshot and policy inputs
  truncate: reject truncation of retained inbox, snapshots, inputs and receipts
  rollback: refuse any retained work/input/receipt under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks
  application: separate later Student-owned boundary

Hybrid_application_delivery_v1:
  migration: 022_hybrid_application
  source: immutable_021_consequence_receipt
  owner_effect: Student_registered_application_HTTP_boundary
  claim: expiring_token_lease_fenced_durable_delivery_work
  completion: exact_Student_APPLIED_or_NO_CHANGE_receipt
  retry: WAITING_SAFE_BOUNDARY_or_transient_unavailable
  stale: local_fresh_snapshot_generation_preserves_real_Student_event_provenance
  lost_response: resend_exact_consequence_obtain_original_Student_receipt
  mutation: no_Planner_write_to_Student_path_or_intent
